EnvironmentId.title: EnvironmentId
EnvironmentId.description: Power Platform environment GUID from ELM ProvisioningCompleted event.

EnvironmentName.title: EnvironmentName
EnvironmentName.description: Display name of the provisioned environment.

Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: Governance zone classification (1 = Personal Productivity, 2 = Team Collaboration, 3 = Enterprise Managed).

ProvisionedBy.title: ProvisionedBy
ProvisionedBy.description: UPN or identity that triggered the provisioning.

Initialize_DataverseUrl.description: Dataverse environment URL (e.g., https://org.crm.dynamics.com). Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_DataverseUrl.

Initialize_TenantId.description: Entra ID tenant GUID. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TenantId.

Initialize_ClientId.description: App registration client ID for certificate-based Graph auth. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ClientId.

Initialize_CertificateThumbprint.description: Certificate thumbprint for unattended authentication. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_CertificateThumbprint.

Initialize_SubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID containing the Automation account. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_SubscriptionId.

Initialize_ResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group containing the Automation account. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ResourceGroup.

Initialize_AutomationAccount.description: Azure Automation account name. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_AutomationAccount.

Initialize_TeamsGroupId.description: Microsoft Teams team/group ID for alert notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TeamsGroupId.

Initialize_TeamsChannelId.description: Microsoft Teams channel ID for alert notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TeamsChannelId.

Initialize_ComplianceDistributionList.description: Email distribution list for compliance alert routing. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ComplianceDistributionList.

Initialize_VerificationStatus.description: Child flow output: Passed, Failed, or Error.

Initialize_GapsFound.description: Count of compliance gaps detected during zone verification.

Initialize_AlertSent.description: Whether an alert was dispatched to Teams/email.

Initialize_Severity.description: Severity classification: Critical (Zone 3), High (Zone 2), Warning (Zone 1), or Passed.

Compute_Zone_Severity.description: Map zone to severity: Zone 3 → Critical, Zone 2 → High, Zone 1 → Warning.

Compute_Zone_Container_Style.description: Map zone to adaptive card container style: Zone 3 → attention, Zone 2 → warning, Zone 1 → accent.

Compute_Zone_Label.inputs: @if(equals(triggerBody()?['Zone'], 3), 'Zone 3 — Enterprise Managed', if(equals(triggerBody()?['Zone'], 2), 'Zone 2 — Team Collaboration', 'Zone 1 — Personal Productivity'))
Compute_Zone_Label.description: Human-readable zone label for alert messages.

Generate_Job_Id.description: Generate a unique GUID for the Azure Automation job.

Create_Automation_Job.description: Start zone-scoped Azure Automation runbook with -Zone and -Scope Targeted for provisioning verification.

Wait_Loop.description: Poll Azure Automation job status every 30 seconds until completed, failed, or suspended (30-minute timeout for provisioning hook).

Get_Job_Output.description: Retrieve the runbook output JSON from the completed Azure Automation job.

Parse_Results.description: Parse the structured JSON output from Start-CAAValidationRunbook (zone-scoped, targeted scan).

Evaluate_Verification_Outcome.description: Determine verification outcome: Passed (no failures) or Failed (gaps found — severity mapped from zone).

List_Validation_Records.description: Query Dataverse to verify the runbook wrote the validation history record with Targeted scope tag.

Create_Fallback_Record.description: Fallback: create validation history record with Targeted scope if the runbook failed to write to Dataverse.

Verify_Dataverse_Record.description: Verify the runbook wrote an immutable validation history record to Dataverse with Targeted scope tag.

Create_Violation_Record.description: Create Dataverse violation record tagged as provisioning-triggered for audit trail.

Apply_to_Each_Violation.description: Write each compliance gap as a fsi_CAPolicyViolation record tagged with provisioning context.

Write_Violations_to_Dataverse.description: Write individual violation records to Dataverse when gaps are found, tagged as provisioning-triggered.

Compose_Provisioning_Alert_Card.description: Compose provisioning-context adaptive card with zone-appropriate severity styling.

Post_Provisioning_Teams_Alert.description: Post provisioning verification alert to the designated Teams channel.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
CA Policy Provisioning Verification — @{variables('VerificationStatus')}

Severity: @{outputs('Compute_Zone_Severity')}

Checked At: @{body('Parse_Results')?['CheckedAt']}

Provisioning Context

Environment@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentName']}
Environment ID@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentId']}
Zone@{outputs('Compute_Zone_Label')}
Provisioned By@{triggerBody()?['ProvisionedBy']}
Provisioned At@{triggerBody()?['ProvisionedAt']}

Verification Summary

Total Policies@{body('Parse_Results')?['TotalPolicies']}
Passed@{body('Parse_Results')?['PassedCount']}
Failed@{body('Parse_Results')?['FailedCount']}
Compliance Rate@{body('Parse_Results')?['ComplianceRate']}%
Scan ScopeTargeted (Provisioning)

Review CA policies in the Entra Portal.

View environment in the Power Platform Admin Center.

This alert was generated by the CAA Provisioning Hook flow.

Send_Provisioning_Alert_Email.description: Send provisioning verification alert email with zone-specific severity.

Check_Alert_Required.description: Route alerts only when AlertRequired is true — gaps found in zone CA policy coverage.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
[CRITICAL] Provisioning CA Verification Job Failed

The CA policy verification triggered by environment provisioning did not complete successfully.

Environment@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentName']}
Environment ID@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentId']}
Zone@{outputs('Compute_Zone_Label')}
Job ID@{outputs('Generate_Job_Id')}
Job Status@{body('Get_Job_Status')?['properties']?['status']}
Automation Account@{variables('AutomationAccount')}

Please check the Azure Automation account for detailed error information.

This alert was generated by the CAA Provisioning Hook flow.

Send_Provisioning_Job_Failure_Email.description: Send CRITICAL email when the provisioning verification runbook fails.

parameters.message/body/content:
[CRITICAL] Provisioning CA Verification Job Failed

The CA policy verification triggered by environment provisioning did not complete successfully.

Environment: @{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentName']}

Zone: @{outputs('Compute_Zone_Label')}

Job ID: @{outputs('Generate_Job_Id')}

Status: @{body('Get_Job_Status')?['properties']?['status']}

Check the Azure Automation account for details.

Post_Provisioning_Job_Failure_Teams.description: Post CRITICAL provisioning job failure notification to Teams channel.

Check_Job_Status.description: Branch based on Azure Automation job status: Completed → parse results, verify Dataverse, write violations, route alerts; Failed/Suspended → send CRITICAL notification.

Scope_Try.description: Main execution scope: run zone-scoped Azure Automation verification, parse results, write violations, and route alerts.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
[CRITICAL] CAA Provisioning Hook — Flow Failure

The CAA provisioning hook flow encountered an unexpected error during CA policy verification.

Environment@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentName']}
Environment ID@{triggerBody()?['EnvironmentId']}
Zone@{triggerBody()?['Zone']}
Flow Run ID@{workflow()['run']['name']}
Timestamp@{utcNow()}

Please investigate the flow run history in the Power Automate portal for detailed error information.

This alert was generated by the CAA Provisioning Hook flow error handler.

Send_Flow_Error_Email.description: Send CRITICAL error email when any unexpected failure occurs in the provisioning hook flow.

Scope_Catch.description: Error handling scope: catches unexpected failures in Scope_Try and sends CRITICAL notification.

Return_Output.description: Return verification results to the parent ELM flow: VerificationStatus, GapsFound, AlertSent, Severity.

properties.description: Child flow triggered by ELM ProvisioningCompleted event. Runs zone-scoped CA policy compliance verification, writes violations to Dataverse, and routes severity-classified alerts. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511/3110, SEC 17a-3/4, SOX 302/404. Part of the FSI Agent Governance — Conditional Access Automation solution.
